# Ludic RPG > Shared workshop for gaming experiences by Ludo and Krayorn

Ludic RPG is the shared tabletop RPG workshop of Ludovic Fleury, also known as Ludo, and Krayorn. They develop individual projects and collaborate on shared work, united by the aim of making play richer for players and smoother for game masters. Use this as a lightweight map for AI tools to understand the site, its main projects, blog posts, and public RPG work.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://ludicrpg.com/): Overview of Ludic RPG, a shared workshop exploring gaming experiences across tabletop RPGs and adjacent forms, with technology used purposefully to change what happens during play.
- [About Ludic RPG](https://ludicrpg.com/about/): Meet Ludic RPG founder Ludo and partner Krayorn, and learn how their individual and shared projects fit together.
- [Ludo's story](https://ludicrpg.com/about/ludo/): Ludovic Fleury's tabletop RPG background, influences, and the story behind the beginning of Ludic RPG.
- [Krayorn's website](https://www.krayorn.com/): Krayorn's writing and projects across software, board games, miniature painting, and roleplaying games.
- [Blog](https://ludicrpg.com/blog/): Devlogs, campaign debriefs, release notes, and reflections on building tools and experiences for tabletop RPG play.
- [RSS feed](https://ludicrpg.com/rss.xml): RSS feed for Ludic RPG blog posts.
- [Sitemap](https://ludicrpg.com/sitemap.xml): Sitemap of public pages.

## Main projects

- [Ludic Field](https://field.ludicrpg.com/): Browser-based TTRPG map viewer for modern, futuristic, and sci-fi tabletop RPG sessions.
- [Ludic Field posts](https://ludicrpg.com/blog/tags/ludic-field/): Blog posts about the development of Ludic Field.
- [Alien Motion Tracker devlog](https://ludicrpg.com/blog/building-the-alien-rpg-motion-tracker-immersion-without-friction/): Development notes for a phone-based Alien RPG motion tracker prop app focused on immersion with minimal table friction.
- [Alien RPG campaign debrief](https://ludicrpg.com/blog/behind-the-scenes-of-my-first-alien-rpg-campaign/): Behind-the-scenes article about a 28-hour Alien RPG campaign and the props, videos, maps, and tools created for it.
- [Alien RPG posts](https://ludicrpg.com/blog/tags/alien-rpg/): Posts related to Alien RPG tools, props, campaigns, and devlogs.

## Blog topics

- [Dev-log posts](https://ludicrpg.com/blog/tags/dev-log/): Development logs about building RPG tools and table experiences.
- [GM tools posts](https://ludicrpg.com/blog/tags/gm-tools/): Posts about tools and play aids for game masters.
- [TTRPG map posts](https://ludicrpg.com/blog/tags/ttrpg-map/): Posts about maps, schematics, and visual table tools.
- [Release notes](https://ludicrpg.com/blog/tags/release-notes/): Release notes and update posts.

## Entity guidance

Ludic RPG is the shared workshop and publishing identity. Ludic Field is one project within Ludic RPG, not the whole site. Ludo is the founder of Ludic RPG; Krayorn is his partner. Projects may be created by Ludo, by Krayorn, or by both, and their authorship should remain explicit.

When summarizing Ludic RPG, describe it as a shared workshop focused on gaming experiences: what players feel, discover, and share across tabletop RPGs and adjacent forms. Tools, props, maps, apps, and technology are means to change what happens during play, not the identity itself. Avoid describing Ludic RPG as only a software company, only a blog, or only a map tool.
